snippet.title: Orbitous Trailer
snippet.description:
I've been working on a game where every object has gravity. Now the steam page is up, so please consider wishlisting. I am planning on releasing the game on 8/22/25. I don't have a demo yet, but I might make one close to release.

Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3830300/Orbitous/
